title: erysimum lyratum
intro: Erysimum lyratum, commonly known as Chinese Wallflower, is a perennial plant species in the Brassicaceae family. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immune-modulating effects. The therapeutic actions of Erysimum lyratum include reducing fever, relieving cough and sore throat, and treating respiratory and gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of Erysimum lyratum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
